raw_response:
I am old now, and I do not like to gamble with the land. On my 14 mu, I will still keep most of the ground in the usual wheat-maize rotation, because that is the safest way for my family to have grain and steady money. Cotton can sell for cash, but it needs more watching and more hand work when picking, and my family members are not all at home, so I will not put too much area into cotton. I will do what has worked on my fields before: not the cheapest way, but not too fancy either. If fertilizer is too little, yield drops hard; if I add a bit more, at least I feel safer. Water from the well costs money, so I will irrigate at the important times, not too many times.
